video.title: AI欧腐《糟糕！我和死对头有个孩子/Oops! I Had a Baby with My Nemesis》
video.desc:
Top actor Julian and Oscar winner Adrian are sworn rivals — until five-year-old Theo from the future appears, claiming both are his father. DNA confirms it, forcing the enemies to cohabit and raise the boy. Amid diaper-duty chaos, their buried crushes surface and misunderstandings dissolve. Through public scrutiny and career crossroads, they confess their love, face the backlash, and end with a proposal and wedding. A time-travel twist turns bitter rivals into a family they choose for themselves.
顶流男星 Julian 与奥斯卡影帝 Adrian 是圈内公认的死对头，直到来自未来的五岁男孩 Theo 从天而降，声称两人都是他的爸爸。亲子鉴定证实了这一切，这对冤家被迫同居，一起养娃。在鸡飞狗跳的带娃日常中，深埋心底的暗恋渐渐浮出水面，误会也一一解开。面对舆论的审视与事业的抉择，他们向彼此告白，携手扛过风波，最终以求婚和婚礼圆满收场。一场穿越时空的意外，让针锋相对的宿敌成为了他们自己选择的家人。
